title: Constitutional Reforms Strengthen the Defense of Mexican Sovereignty, Sheinbaum Says
author: Fernanda Monroy
content:
_This article by[Fernanda
Monroy](https://contralinea.com.mx/author/fermonroy/) originally appeared in
the [October 12, 2026 edition of
Contralínea](https://contralinea.com.mx/interno/semana/reformas-
constitucionales-refuerzan-la-defensa-de-la-soberania-mexicana-sheinbaum/), an
investigative Mexican news outlet._

**President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo** **highlighted the amendments to Articles
40 and 19 of the Constitution** of the United Mexican States as part of the
**defense of national sovereignty against foreign interference**. She also
referred to the **provisions that allow elections to be annulled when it is
proven that a foreign intervention influenced their results.**

During the October 12 morning press conference, Claudia Sheinbaum maintained
that the **protection of national independence is not only the
responsibility** of the **government, but also of the citizenry**. To support
this position, she recalled the **reforms approved in 2025** and pointed to
other measures adopted to prevent foreign interventions in the country's
political and security affairs.

**Article 40 of the Constitution was amended** to establish that **Mexico will
not accept interventions, meddling or acts from abroad that harm the
integrity, independence and sovereignty of the nation.** The provision
expressly includes coups d'état, interference in elections and violations of
national territory by land, water, sea or airspace.

The reform also establishes that the Mexican State will not consent to
interventions in investigations and prosecutions without its express
authorization and collaboration, in accordance with the applicable legal
framework. The corresponding decree was published in the **_Diario Oficial de
la Federación_ on April 1, 2025.**

In the same package of amendments,**Article 19 of the Constitution**
incorporated **provisions applicable to Mexican nationals or foreigners
involved in the manufacture, distribution, sale, transfer or illicit
introduction of weapons into national territory**. It also included foreigners
who carry out unlawful activities linked to the second and third paragraphs of
Article 40. For these cases, the text establishes the most severe penalty
possible and the precautionary measure of mandatory pretrial detention.

The head of the federal Executive also mentioned the provisions that allow
**an election to be annulled when it is proven that there was foreign
interference that influenced its results.**

The measure was incorporated into**Article 41 of the Constitution through a
decree published on June 2, 2026.** The reform added as grounds for electoral
nullity the proof of acts of foreign intervention or interference that
influence the results of the elections.

Referring to these measures, the president stated that the**defense of
sovereignty must be a permanent task.** In her remarks, she questioned those
who seek foreign backing in the absence of popular support and compared that
stance to that of the**conservative sectors of the 19th century** that turned
abroad to promote the arrival of **Maximilian of Habsburg in Mexico.** "**What
do all of us who believe in sovereignty and independence have to do? Defend
it**."
